# `Q-20-4` — Filter Params Blob Too Large

> The `QUARTO_FILTER_PARAMS` payload passed to pandoc's Lua filters exceeds
> the platform's environment-block size limit.

## What this means

Quarto passes configuration to pandoc's Lua filters through a single
environment variable, `QUARTO_FILTER_PARAMS`, carrying a base64-encoded JSON
payload. Some platforms (Windows, via `CreateProcess`) reject an entire
environment block larger than 32,767 characters. When the built payload
would exceed that limit, the subprocess cannot even be started with the
parameters it needs.

## Why this happens

The most common cause is a large `include-in-header` (or similar) file
whose full text gets inlined into the params payload rather than referenced
by path.

## How to fix

Reduce the size of whatever content is being inlined into filter params —
most commonly, shrink or split a large `include-in-header` file. There is
currently no automatic fallback to a temp-file-based transport for
oversized payloads.
